title: Builder Signals · 2026-08-14
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 33 条 X 动态、1 集播客、3 篇博客；本站精选 17 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Following same-day model releases from DeepSeek and Grok, Levie reads it as Jevons paradox playing out for AI: both updates deliver huge capability jumps at insanely low costs, and lowering the cost of AI accelerates rather than dampens demand. Enterprises he talks to have vastly more use cases they'd like agents to handle than they can budget for today—scanning codebases for security issues, reviewing all their documents, processing information across large portions of their workflows. Every cost drop or capabili…
featured.insightZh: DeepSeek 和 Grok 同日发布新模型，Levie 的解读是：这是 AI 版的杰文斯悖论正在上演。两次更新都是「能力大跳 + 成本极低」的组合，而成本下降不会减少需求，只会加速需求。他说和企业客户聊下来，对方想让 agent 干的事情远远超出当前预算能覆盖的范围——让 agent 扫描整个代码库找安全漏洞、让 agent 通读所有文档、让 agent 处理大部分工作流中的信息环节。每次 AI 成本下降或能力上台阶，企业侧就会解锁一批全新用例，反过来推高总需求。他还补了一句对应用层的判断：模型选择越多（尤其是针对不同任务类型和成本档位调优过的模型），能够按任务做路由和优化的那一层价值就越大。

featured.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监（前 Google，主导 Gemini / Veo / Nano Banana）
featured.summaryEn: Guru's call for the next few years: the biggest alpha in AI products is in the application layer. Models will keep getting cheaper, better, and more local, so differentiation won't come from there—it will come from deeply understanding specific user workflows and having the imagination to redesign the experience around them. His sharper point: the denominator of people who can build AI products is about to get enormous, so being in the top 0.1% of builders matters more than ever. In a separate note he mourns the l…
featured.insightZh: Madhu Guru 给未来几年 AI 产品下了个很直接的判断：最大的 alpha 在应用层。理由是模型会持续变便宜、变强、变得更本地化——这条曲线是确定的，差异化不会从这里来。真正的差异化来自对特定用户工作流的深度理解，以及有想象力地围绕这些工作流重新设计体验。他补的那句更值得琢磨：能造 AI 产品的人的分母即将变得极其庞大，所以进入 builder 里的前 0.1% 比以往任何时候都更重要。另一条推是关于协作方式的怀旧：他说很怀念团队真的会围着白板画图的时代——站在板前画半成品的想法、互相打断、共同塑形，这种玩兴被疫情后几年的 Zoom 和 Google Meet 磨掉了。

featured.title: 微软 CTO Kevin Scott 谈「为 agent 而生的互联网」
featured.summaryEn: Model reasoning has run ahead of what products actually use—Kevin Scott calls it the "capability overhang." What's blocking agents now isn't intelligence but the absence of an open, composable protocol layer that looks like the internet: MCP is to the agentic web what HTTP is to the internet. Scott contrasts this year with last: the industry no longer needs convincing that scaling laws hold, but reasoning capability has now outpaced what products deliver, leaving a collective gap to close. That's why the main storyline shifted to the agentic web. For agents to be useful they must act on your behalf—use tools, change systems, consult diverse information sources—and that requires an internet-like ecosystem. He explicitly maps MCP onto HTTP's role and NL Web onto HTML's: simple, open, composable, layerable. The most directly applicable enterprise point is what he's pushing internally as Mi…
featured.insightZh: 模型的推理能力已经跑在产品之前了（Kevin Scott 称之为「capability overhang」），现在真正卡住 agent 的不是智能，而是缺一套像互联网那样开放、可组合的协议层——MCP 之于 agentic web，就是 HTTP 之于互联网。 Kevin Scott 对比了去年和今年的主题变化：去年大家还在怀疑 scaling law 会不会失效，今年这个问题基本不用再讨论了；反倒是模型的推理能力已经明显超出了我们在产品里实际用到的程度。他把这个差距叫「能力过剩」（capability overhang），并认为整个行业欠了一笔集体作业——把模型真实具备的能力兑现到用户手里。今年真正的主线因此变成了 agentic web：agent 要有用就必须能代你行动，就必须能调工具、改系统、访问丰富多样的信息源，而这需要一个长得很像互联网的生态。他明确把 MCP 类比成这个新生态里的 HTTP，把 NL Web 类比成 HTML——简单、开放、可组合、能层层叠加。 对企业侧最直接的一段是他作为 CTO 在微软内部推的事：他要求微软所有内部系统对内部所有 agent 讲同一套标准协议。理由是不这么做就会把康威定律暴露给全世界——「你会把你的组织架构图发布出去」。他说眼看着没有标准协议时那种低效重复建设，作为工程师简直是恐怖片。这条对任何做企业级 agent 落地的组织都直接适用：先统一内部协议层，否则每个部门的 agent 都会长成部门墙的形状。 安全模型这块他承认还没有标准答案，但给了明确的构件清单：agent 需要身份（identity），这样才能建授权体系，才能表达「这个 agent 代表这个人行动，它有权访问这些资源」；还需要一种机制让 agent 能去查询「我要做这件事需要触碰哪些系统、需要申请哪些权限」，然后向委托它的人请求许可，同时让各系统管理员也能审批。他强调这些都要用开放方式做，不能锁死在某家的 agent 或系统里。他不认同「封闭才安全、开放才创新」的二分法，认为这可能是个伪命题——开放系统的无需许可（permissionless）特性本身…

items.title: Josh Woodward · Google Labs / Gemini App / AI Studio VP
items.summaryEn: Google is rolling out another wave of Gemini app integrations, with a clear thesis: get things done inside the apps people already use rather than stopping at the chat box. This batch spans services and content—Angi (formerly Angie's List), Fever, GetYourGuide, Granola, iHeartRadio, Localiza, OpenTable, Otter, Pandora, Thumbtack, Ticketmaster, Wix, Zocdoc, and Zoho. The list reads as a systematic effort to wire booking, ticketing, healthcare scheduling, meeting notes, site building, and business software into the…
items.insightZh: Google 又推了一波 Gemini 的第三方应用集成，方向很明确：让 Gemini 在用户日常已经在用的应用里直接把事办了，而不是停在对话框里。这次上线的合作方覆盖生活服务和内容两大类——Angi（原 Angie's List）、Fever、GetYourGuide、Granola、iHeartRadio、Localiza、OpenTable、Otter、Pandora、Thumbtack、Ticketmaster、Wix、Zocdoc、Zoho。从名单看，Google 在系统性地把预订、票务、医疗挂号、会议记录、建站、企业软件这些高频动作接进助手层。Woodward 同时公开招募新的集成伙伴。

items.title: Claude (Anthropic 官方) · Claude 产品账号
items.summaryEn: Anthropic's update turns Claude from a per-device entry point into a session that follows your account. Claude in Chrome sessions now carry over to desktop, web, and mobile, with conversations saved and skills plus connectors working in the browser. The side panel runs the same Claude Cowork session as the desktop, web, and mobile apps—sessions live with your account, not on any single device—so you can start in a tab and resume elsewhere. Available on Max and Team today, rolling out to Pro over the coming weeks.…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 这次更新的重点是把 Claude 从「设备上的一个入口」变成「跟着账号走的一段会话」。Claude in Chrome 的会话现在可以延续到桌面端、Web 端和移动端，对话会被保存，用户的 skills 和 connectors 在浏览器里同样可用；浏览器侧边栏跑的是和桌面 / Web / 移动端同一个 Claude Cowork session，会话归属于账号而不是某台设备，所以可以在一个标签页里开始、之后换个地方接着做。功能今天先给 Max 和 Team，Pro 在未来几周内推。同时官方也点了浏览器 agent 的核心风险：页面里可以藏指令来诱骗 agent，Anthropic 在做防御，但仍然建议用户自己保持几个使用习惯。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Garry Tan is pushing GBrain, his own project: v0.45.6.0 adds 17 new brain skills, hardened through his personal OpenClaw agent running against hundreds of thousands of markdown files, and GBrain now works with Codex and Claude Code. His usage guidance is the notable part: run GBrain as a *separate agent*, not inside your main coding agent—think of it as a personal AI version of ChatGPT or Claude with its own git repo for memory and its own custom skills. He frames the direction as "personal AGI"—one that works for…
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 在推他自己做的 GBrain——最新的 v0.45.6.0 加了 17 个新的 brain skill，他说这些 skill 是在自己那个带几十万个 markdown 文件的 OpenClaw agent 上实打实磨出来的，现在 GBrain 也支持 Codex 和 Claude Code。他给出的用法建议值得注意：跑 GBrain 应该是一个独立的 agent，不要塞进你的主编码 agent 里；把它想成一个私人版的 ChatGPT / Claude，有自己的 git repo 当记忆、有自己的自定义 skills。他给这个方向起的名字是「personal AGI」——为你个人服务的那种。他还顺手总结了当前的技术风向：接下来大家都会往 markdown skill 上堆。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程与访谈创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang published a new essay arguing that the way we use computers is about to change forever: from doing work manually with a keyboard, mouse, and laptop to directing agents in the cloud using our voices. He builds it on three claims—voice is becoming the orchestration layer, personal computers will move to the cloud, and trust will be the key differentiator. The third point matters most for enterprises: once agents act on your behalf in the cloud, trustworthiness rather than feature lists decides who wins. T…
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 发了篇新长文，核心主张是：我们用计算机的方式很快会被彻底改写——从用键盘、鼠标、笔记本手动干活，转向用语音指挥云端的 agent 干活。文章讲了三条论据：一是语音正在成为编排层（orchestration layer），二是个人电脑会往云端迁移，三是信任会成为关键差异点。第三点对企业侧尤其相关——当 agent 在云上代你执行，可信度而非功能清单会决定选谁。文章免费公开。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Rauch is highlighting an upgrade to Vercel Sandbox: `npx sandbox@latest sh` now opens a cloud shell that, in his words, "feels faster than your local machine." The update ships a reasonable default set of pre-installed tools while remaining fully customizable. Separately, Seedance 2.5 is now live on the Vercel AI Gateway. Taken together, the direction is consistent: make remote execution environments plus multi-model access the out-of-the-box default, so neither an agent's hands nor its brain need to stay local.
items.insightZh: Rauch 在推 Vercel Sandbox 的一次体验升级：现在 `npx sandbox@latest sh` 可以直接开一个云端 shell，他的评价是「感觉比本地机器还快」。这次更新给 sandbox 预装了一套合理的默认工具集，同时允许完全自定义。另一条是 Seedance 2.5 已经上到 Vercel AI Gateway。两条放一起，方向是一致的：把「远端执行环境 + 多模型接入」做成开箱即用的默认设施，让 agent 的手和脑都不必留在本地。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 核心开发者
items.summaryEn: Steinberger compressed the evolution of AI agent products into one line: CLI was a year ago, apps maybe six months, now it's services, web, and cloud sessions. The timeline itself functions as a roadmap—each phase lasts roughly six to twelve months, and the shift from command line to hosted service is moving faster than most teams' planning cycles.
items.insightZh: Steinberger 用一句话概括了 AI agent 产品形态的演进节奏：CLI 是一年前的事，app 大概是半年前的事，现在的战场是服务、Web 和云端 session。这个时间轴本身就是一份路线图——每个阶段大约只维持六到十二个月，交付形态从命令行走向托管服务的速度比大多数团队的规划周期还快。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · SPC 普通合伙人（前 Dropbox CTO）
items.summaryEn: Agarwal is publicly bullish on India: SPC India was their first bet outside the US, and he expects some of the most ambitious projects of the decade to be built there, arguing "Indian dynamism is here to stay." The same day, the firm spoke to ETtech about SPC. For teams planning global delivery footprints, this is a capital signal worth noting—a top US founder community treating India as a second home market rather than an outsourcing back office.
items.insightZh: Agarwal 公开表态看多印度：SPC India 是他们在美国之外的第一笔布局，他认为这个十年里最有野心的一批项目会诞生在那里，「印度的活力会持续下去」。同一天他们接受了 ETtech 的采访谈 SPC。对做全球交付布局的团队来说，这是一个值得留意的资本信号——顶级美国创业社区正在把印度当成第二主场而非外包腹地。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark 风险投资人
items.summaryEn: Turck's deadpan summary of AI engineering's terminology inflation: "Graph engineering is the new loop engineering which is the new harness engineering which is the new context engineering which is the new prompt engineering. Hope this clarifies any confusion." The joke points at a real problem—the underlying challenge (reliably embedding models into real workflows) hasn't changed, but relabeling it every few months makes it harder for buyers and teams to tell genuinely new capability from new packaging.
items.insightZh: Turck 用一句反讽总结了这两年 AI 工程圈的术语通胀：「图工程是新的循环工程，循环工程是新的 harness 工程，harness 工程是新的上下文工程，上下文工程是新的提示工程。希望这澄清了所有困惑。」玩笑之下是一个真问题——底层要解决的事情（怎么把模型可靠地嵌进真实工作流）没变，但每隔几个月就换一套词汇，会让采购方和团队难以判断到底哪些是新能力、哪些只是新包装。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人
items.summaryEn: Two cadence signals from the Codex team: Linux support has shipped ("also don't say Linux, we just shipped that"), and another usage reset was landing within the hour, with a nudge to use /fast. The sheer density of the release cadence is itself an indicator of how hard OpenAI is currently pushing Codex.
items.insightZh: 来自 Codex 团队的两条节奏信号：一是 Linux 支持已经发布（「别再说 Linux 了，我们刚发」），二是又一次限额重置正在推送，他让大家「用 /fast」。发布节奏之密集，本身就是 Codex 当前投入强度的指标。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder，本简报信源作者
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang recommends a Stanford lecture series as "pure gold," noting how remarkable it is that knowledge of this quality is freely disseminated on YouTube. For teams running internal AI capability building, high-quality free lecture series like this are ready-made, low-cost upskilling material.
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 推荐了一套斯坦福的公开课系列，评价是「纯金」，并感慨这种质量的知识现在可以在 YouTube 上免费获取。对内部做 AI 能力建设的团队来说，这类高质量免费课程是低成本 upskilling 的现成素材。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: A piece of industry self-satire worth reading: Shipper announced he's starting a content agency called "One Word" to help AI labs grow on X by posting one word a day. "This is the new meta. Don't just go direct. Go one word at a time." He followed up with "Update: we're rebranding to 'Word,' it's cleaner." The joke lands on how the minimalist, cryptic, drip-fed teasing style has become a fixed playbook for AI companies on social media.
items.insightZh: 一则值得一读的行业自嘲：Shipper 说他要开一家叫「One Word」的内容代理公司，专门帮 AI 实验室在 X 上增长——方法是每天只发一个词。「这才是新的 meta。不要只是 go direct，要一次一个词地 go。」他随后又补了一句「我们决定改名叫 Word，更干净」。玩笑指向的是当下 AI 公司在社交媒体上极简、神秘、挤牙膏式的预热风格已经成为固定套路。

items.title: Claude Code 质量下降报告的复盘
items.summaryEn: Anthropic published an unusually candid postmortem: a month of reports that Claude had gotten worse traced to three independent changes affecting Claude Code, the Agent SDK, and Claude Cowork, with the API unaffected; all three were resolved by April 20 (v2.1.116). First, on March 4 they lowered Claude Code's default reasoning effort from high to medium to fix tail latency that made the UI appear frozen—users said they'd rather default to higher intelligence and opt down for simple tasks, so it was reverted April 7. Second and most damaging, a March 26 caching optimization meant to clear old thinking once for sessions idle over an hour had a bug that cleared it every turn thereafter; Claude kept executing while progressively losing the record of why it made its choices, surfacing as forgetfulness, repetition, and odd tool choices, while the resulting cache misses also drained usage limi…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 罕见地公开了一份事故复盘：过去一个月用户反馈 Claude 变差，追查下来是三个互相独立的变更所致，全部影响 Claude Code / Agent SDK / Claude Cowork，API 未受影响，三个问题均已在 4 月 20 日（v2.1.116）修复。第一个：3 月 4 日把 Claude Code 默认 reasoning effort 从 high 降到 medium，本意是解决高强度思考导致 UI 看起来卡死的长尾延迟，但用户明确表示宁可默认更聪明、简单任务再手动降档，4 月 7 日回滚。第二个也是最严重的：3 月 26 日上线的缓存优化本应只在会话闲置超过一小时时清理一次旧的 thinking，但实现有 bug，导致此后该会话的每一轮都在清——Claude 会继续执行任务，却越来越不记得自己为什么这么做，表现为健忘、重复、工具选择怪异，同时因为持续 cache miss 还额外拖垮了用量额度。第三个：4 月 16 日随 Opus 4.7 加的一条系统提示（把工具调用间文本压到 25 词以内、最终回复压到 100 词以内）意外拉低了编码质量，消融实验显示 Opus 4.6 和 4.7 都掉了 3%，4 月 20 日回滚。 最值得工程组织借鉴的是「为什么没被拦住」这部分：这个缓存 bug 通过了多轮人工与自动代码评审、单元测试、端到端测试、自动化验证和内部 dogfooding，因为它只在陈旧会话这个边角场景触发，加上两个不相关的实验掩盖了症状，团队花了一周多才定位根因。三个变更影响不同流量切片、时间表也不同，叠加起来才呈现为「广泛而不一致的性能退化」这种最难排查的形态。改进措施同样具体：让更多内部员工使用与公众完全一致的构建版本；对系统提示变更加更严的管控，每次变更跑全套 per-model eval 并做逐行消融；任何可能牺牲智能的改动都要加浸泡期、扩大 eval 套件、灰度放量。他们还回测发现，在提供完整仓库上下文的前提下 Opus 4.7 能找出这个 bug 而 4.6 找不到，因此正在给 Code Review 增加多仓…

items.title: Managed Agents 架构：把「大脑」和「双手」解耦
items.summaryEn: This engineering post traces the architecture of Claude Managed Agents from a valuable premise: a harness encodes assumptions about what Claude can't do on its own, and those assumptions go stale as models improve. Their own example—Sonnet 4.5 wrapping up tasks prematurely as it sensed its context limit ("context anxiety"), which they patched with harness-level context resets, only to find the behavior gone on Opus 4.5, leaving the resets as dead weight. Expecting harnesses to keep evolving, they virtualized agent components into interfaces meant to outlast any implementation—the same move operating systems made decades ago with process and file to support "programs as yet unthought of," where read() is agnostic to a 1970s disk pack or a modern SSD. The decomposition is session (an append-only log of everything that happened), harness (the loop that calls Claude and routes tool calls),…
items.insightZh: 这篇是 Anthropic 讲 Managed Agents 架构演进的工程文章，起点是一个很有价值的观察：harness（agent 外壳）本质上是在编码「模型自己做不到什么」的假设，而这些假设会随模型变强迅速过期。他们举了自己的例子——Sonnet 4.5 会因为感知到上下文快满而提前草草收尾（所谓 context anxiety），他们为此在 harness 里加了 context reset；换到 Opus 4.5 上这个行为消失了，那段代码就变成了死重量。既然 harness 注定持续演化，他们选择的做法是把 agent 的组件虚拟化成一组能比任何具体实现活得更久的接口——这是几十年前操作系统用 process、file 这类抽象来支持「尚未被想到的程序」的同一套思路，read() 不关心底下是 1970 年代的磁盘还是现代 SSD。 具体拆成三块：session（记录全部发生过的事的只追加日志）、harness（调用 Claude 并把工具调用路由到相应基础设施的循环）、sandbox（Claude 跑代码改文件的执行环境）。最初三者塞在同一个容器里，好处是文件编辑就是直接的系统调用、没有服务边界要设计，坏处是他们「养了个宠物」——容器挂了会话就没了，容器卡了得人工抢救，而唯一的观察窗口是 WebSocket 事件流，harness 的 bug、事件流丢包、容器下线三种故障长得一模一样；更糟的是排查要进容器开 shell，但容器里往往有用户数据，等于根本没法调试。解耦之后，harness 离开容器，用 execute(name, input) → string 像调用任何工具一样调用容器，容器变成「牲口」——挂了就当工具调用失败抛回给 Claude，Claude 要重试就用 provision({resources}) 起个新的。harness 自己也变成牲口：因为 session 日志在 harness 之外，崩了就 wake(sessionId)、getSession(id) 取回事件日志、从最后一个事件续跑。 安全边界的重构值得单独看：耦合设计里 C…

items.title: Managed Agents 新增自托管沙箱与 MCP 隧道
items.summaryEn: This is the product landing of the architecture post, and both capabilities target enterprise compliance directly. Self-hosted sandboxes: a Claude Managed Agent can now execute tools on infrastructure you control, keeping code execution, sensitive files, packages, services, and data inside your enterprise perimeter under your own security and runtime controls. The agent loop handling orchestration, context management, and error recovery stays on Anthropic's infrastructure while tool execution moves to your environment. Because you control the compute, resource sizing and the runtime image are set on your side, so compute-heavy work like long builds or image generation gets the CPU, memory, and capacity it needs. Bring any sandbox client, or start with a supported provider: Cloudflare (microVMs plus lighter-weight isolates, zero-trust secrets injection, customizable proxies to audit, rer…
items.insightZh: 这是上一篇架构文章的产品落地，两个能力都直指企业合规痛点。自托管沙箱：Claude Managed Agent 现在可以在你自己控制的基础设施上执行工具，代码执行、敏感文件、依赖包、服务和数据全部留在企业边界之内，受你自己的安全与运行时管控；负责编排、上下文管理和错误恢复的 agent loop 仍留在 Anthropic 侧，只有工具执行下沉到你的环境。因为算力也在你手里，资源规格和运行时镜像由你决定，长构建或图像生成这类重负载可以按需给足 CPU 和内存。可自带沙箱客户端，也可直接用已支持的托管方：Cloudflare（microVM 加轻量 isolate，零信任密钥注入、可审计与改写出站流量、可经其网络访问内部服务，Amplitude 正基于此构建内部设计 agent）、Daytona（长时运行有状态的完整可组合计算机，会话期间可经 SSH 或鉴权预览 URL 访问，可暂停并完整恢复状态，Clay 的 GTM 工程 agent Sculptor 跑在上面）、Modal（自研容器运行时，任意镜像亚秒级启动，可扩展到数十万并发沙箱，CPU/GPU 按需）、Vercel（VM 级安全 + VPC 对等 + 自带云，毫秒级启动，凭据在网络边界注入因此从不进入沙箱，面向机构金融的 Rogo 正基于此构建分析师 agent）。MCP 隧道：让 Managed Agents 连到你私有网络内的 MCP 服务器而无需暴露到公网——内部数据库、私有 API、知识库、工单系统都能变成 agent 可调用的工具。做法是部署一个轻量网关，只建立一条出站连接，不需要入站防火墙规则、没有公网端点、流量端到端加密。目前自托管沙箱为公开测试版，MCP 隧道为研究预览（需申请），隧道同时支持 Managed Agents 和 Messages API，由组织管理员在 Claude Console 的工作区设置中管理。
